method: Sequential before/after runs of benchmark-trial-state.mjs, 2386 fixed 120 Hz steps, actual anatomy, Berenstein catheter advance/hold/withdraw. Before uses a copy of the source tree saved immediately before these edits.
caveats: Rendering omitted; this is not a capture of the interactive browser pose.
Browser remained running on the same machine. Absolute timing and speedup depend on system load.

Per-step pose equality compares the existing poseFingerprint (positions, velocities and orientations). Exact rollback bytes, contact ownership, friction history and property semantics are also checked by focused tests.
The optimization preserves the 800 unconverged nonlinear steps in this workload; it does not solve that existing convergence problem.
